notes: 2026-11-14: reconciled 10 distinct original articles from alternate parallel PR #55 (L02-005 etc.) into fresh IDs L02-011 through L15-011 as specified in docs/reading-450-parallel-authoring.md.
Authoritative development total 153→163, remaining 287 of 450; main/production registered 28 unchanged; 135 development-only drafts.
Recovered content totals: 4,058 English words, 275 bilingual sentence pairs, 513 vocabulary entries, 100 comprehension MCQ and 160 review exercises.
PR #55 and #56 diverged from the same base with nine colliding IDs containing different lesson content. Do not merge PR #55 blindly; recovered copies are on coord/reading-450-registry.

Shared registry docs/reading-450-ledger.json uses SHA-based reservation writes to prevent two compliant chats from choosing the same ID. scripts/reading_450_guard.py checks local manifest/ledger and content integrity.
Human semantic editing and factual link verification are required before publication; no main merge or Vercel production deploy.
